thread:
maia: deploy-bot blocked RC6 - SBOM present but vuln-scan flagged a new transitive lib (net-conn 0.9.4) with medium CVE. tagging security.
ops-bot: scan summary: net-conn@0.9.4 -> CVE-2025-1234 (medium). SBOM attached: /sboms/rc6.json. Recommendation: triage for exploitability.
dylan: does this hit any runtime surface we changed in RC6? we added async networking layer.
sophia: yeah RC6 upgrades net-conn for async sockets. exploit needs crafted packet and outdated TLS handshake. Hosted gateways terminate TLS, but on-prem may not.
sec-bot: triage: exploit requires unauthenticated external exposure to raw sockets. Hosted default is behind gateway so low risk. Recommend: (1) allow hosted rollout with gateway-only ingress and WAF rule enabled, (2) pause on-prem and edge customers, (3) create approval exception with mitigation evidence.
maia: can we do a temporary WAF rule block for the handshake pattern? ops-bot can deploy rule.
ops-bot: applying WAF rule now to gateway-prod and gateway-canary. Rule id: waf-rc6-2025-1234.
dylan: also, can we timebox an EU canary for hosted customers only while we rebuild with patched net-conn 0.9.5?
sophia: rebuild ETA ~5h. Hotpatching libs at runtime not feasible without rebuild.
support-team: CS: two enterprise on-prem rollouts scheduled tomorrow; we should notify and pause.
maia: propose: Hosted phased rollout (US -> EU) with WAF in place, EU canary 30m 1% traffic. On-prem paused. Security to get net-conn audit and CVSS exploitability note attached to approval.
sec-bot: conditional sign-off: attach exploitability analysis and WAF logs within 2 hours; file approval request ID: AP-1757773333.
dylan: deploy command ready: ```/deploy --image redwood/inference:rc6 --canary region=eu traffic=1% duration=30m ingress=gateway-only``` deploy-bot will enforce ingress and waf.
ops-bot: canary scheduled: rc6-eu-canary in 10m. monitoring: https://obs.redwood/canaries/rc6-eu.
maia: prepping release notes: "RC6: transitive dependency net-conn flagged; hosted rollout proceeds with WAF mitigation; on-prem paused pending patched build."
sophia: once rebuild completes, we'll produce SBOM delta and signed artifact.
support-team: notified customers and paused on-prem deployments.
maia: (after) WAF applied and canary running. attaching initial WAF logs: https://obs.redwood/waf/logs/waf-rc6-2025-1234.txt
sec-bot: received logs; no exploit patterns observed in 25m. evidence attached to AP-1757773333.
dylan: starting rebuild now. ETA 5h.
maia: closing thread for coordination. will update approvals and release ticket when patched artifacts signed. :white_check_mark:
